items.stem: A sales sheet has a column of order totals in B2:B40. You need the total only of orders above 500. Which function fits best?

options.rationale: Correct: SUMIF sums only the cells meeting the criterion ">500".
SUM adds every value, ignoring the condition.
COUNTIF returns how many cells qualify, not their sum.
AVERAGEIF returns the mean of qualifying cells, not the total.

items.explanation: Correct: SUMIF sums only the cells meeting the criterion ">500".

items.stem: You want a printout to repeat the header row at the top of every page. Which Excel feature do you use?

options.rationale: Freeze Panes keeps rows visible on screen, not on printed pages.

options.text: Print Titles (rows to repeat at top)
options.rationale: Correct: Print Titles repeats chosen rows on every printed page.
Split divides the window into panes on screen only.
Group creates a collapsible outline, not repeated print headers.

items.explanation: Correct: Print Titles repeats chosen rows on every printed page.

items.stem: Which TWO actions apply formatting that changes how a value is displayed without changing the stored number? (Select TWO)

options.rationale: Correct: a number format changes the display only; the stored value is unchanged.

options.text: Apply conditional formatting to highlight high values
options.rationale: Correct: conditional formatting changes appearance, not the underlying value.
ROUND changes the computed/stored value, not just the display.
Deleting removes the value entirely rather than formatting it.

items.explanation: Correct: a number format changes the display only; the stored value is unchanged.
